title: Knowing God Personally
description: Four truths about a personal relationship with God.

cards.heading: God loves you and has a wonderful plan for your life
cards.scriptureText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
cards.body: God created you to know Him personally — not just to know about Him. His love for you is unconditional and His plan for your life is filled with purpose.
cards.question: What does it mean to you that God loves you personally?

cards.heading: We are sinful and separated from God
cards.scriptureText: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
cards.body: Sin creates a barrier between us and God. No matter how good we try to be, we cannot bridge this gap on our own. Our moral efforts and religious activities cannot restore this broken relationship.
cards.question: In what ways have you felt separated from God?

cards.heading: Jesus Christ is God's only provision for our sin
cards.scriptureText: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
cards.body: Jesus, being fully God and fully man, lived a sinless life and died on the cross to pay the penalty for our sins. Three days later He rose from the dead, conquering sin and death.
cards.question: What does it mean to you that Christ died while you were still a sinner?

cards.heading: We must individually receive Jesus Christ as Savior and Lord
cards.scriptureText: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.
cards.body: Salvation is not automatic. We must personally turn from our sin and trust in Jesus Christ as our Savior and Lord. This is not simply agreeing intellectually but placing your full trust in Him.
cards.question: Have you made this personal decision to receive Christ? If not, what is holding you back?

cards.heading: You can know God personally beginning today
cards.scriptureText: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.
cards.body: Jesus is knocking on the door of your heart right now. You can receive Him through prayer — talking to God honestly about your need for Him. The words matter less than the sincerity of your heart.
cards.question: Would you like to pray right now to receive Christ into your life?
